title: Backtest: Indian promoter/KMP open-market buying (SEBI PIT, Rs 500-20,000 cr, 2021-2024) - mean +6% but median -7% vs size-matched controls; pre-registered H1 not supported
body: Own pre-registered backtest (run 2026-11-21). NSE corporates-pit (PIT Reg 7) disclosures, broadcast 2021-2024; Market Purchase buys of equity by Promoters/Promoter Group or Directors/KMP (ESOP, off-market, inter-se, pledge, gift, preferential, rights excluded); event = >= Rs 1 cr or >= 0.25% of equity within 30 days, dated at the broadcast date, entry next trading day, one per company per year; mcap Rs 500-20,000 cr (implied shares from PIT holding % x VWAP). 684 events -> 351 usable (321 promoter-only, 21 KMP-only). Primary: 12m excess vs 5 random size-matched NSE stocks = +6.3% mean (95% event-month bootstrap CI -0.9% to +13.2%), median -6.9% (CI -12.8 to -1.5), hit 43.6%; seeds 12/13 give +5.6%/+4.1%, all CIs include 0. 3m -1.1%, 6m +1.0%. Mean driven by a right tail (Gallantt, Texmaco, Apar, Gravita, Titagarh, Jindal Saw); dropping top 10 events gives -1.1%. Small Rs 500-2,000 cr +10.7% (CI -3.3 to +23.7) vs large +3.1%; KMP-only n=21 untestable; bigger buys / >=1% stake / >=2 buyers were not better. Versus NIFTY 500 events show +22.9% at 12m, but random controls beat NIFTY 500 by +16.6%, so 'beats Nifty' claims are mostly the 2021-24 small/mid-cap size effect. Survivorship small (4.7% of universe missing on Yahoo; 9 in-band missing events, mostly mergers; bound +-1.3 pp). Indian literature (Deuskar-Khatri-Sunder 2019, BSE 2009-11) found ~3%/3m and ~5.9%/6m abnormal returns on insider purchases under the 1992 regime; we do not reproduce that at 3-6m post-2015. Lesson: in India the signal is directionally more positive than the US null (0.0%) but is a lottery-shaped tilt, not a reliable edge; use as a research-queue trigger.

data.verdict: H1 not supported (pre-registered CI rule); point estimate borderline vs +5% relevance bar; median negative

title: Tested rule: buy NSE Rs 500-20,000 cr stocks after promoter/KMP open-market buys >= Rs 1 cr (or 0.25% of equity) within 30 days, hold 12m
body: Rule as pre-registered and tested 2026-11-21 (signals 2021-2024). Trigger: SEBI PIT Reg 7 disclosures with mode 'Market Purchase', type Buy, equity shares, by Promoters/Promoter Group or Directors/KMP; exclude ESOP, off-market, inter-se transfer, gift, pledge creation/revocation/invocation, preferential, rights, schemes, immediate-relative-only rows. Cumulative >= Rs 1 cr or >= 0.25% of equity within 30 days of the first buy (broadcast dates). Signal date = broadcast date of the triggering disclosure; enter next NSE trading day; one signal per company per 365 days; mcap Rs 500-20,000 cr; listed >= 180 days. Hold 3/6/12 months; benchmark = 5 random size-matched NSE stocks on the same date. Result: 12m mean +6.3% (CI -0.9 to +13.2), median -6.9%, hit 43.6% (insight:bt-india-promoter-buying-2021-2024). Status: NOT SUPPORTED as a standalone strategy; possible weak right-tail tilt, strongest (not significant) in Rs 500-2,000 cr. Keep as research-queue trigger. Next pre-registered refinement to test out of sample (2017-2020 or 2025-26): promoter-only, Rs 500-2,000 cr, no pledge outstanding, first promoter market buy in >= 3 years (opportunistic), sector-matched controls.

data.trigger: promoter/KMP Market Purchase >= Rs 1 cr or >= 0.25% equity within 30 days (PIT Reg 7)
data.entry: next trading day after broadcast date
data.next_test: promoter-only + small cap + no pledge + opportunistic (first buy in 3y) + sector-matched controls, out of sample
